anthracnose.symptoms: Dark brown to black necrotic spots with chlorotic margins on tender leaves, blossom blight causing flower drop, and black tear-stain rot on fruit.

organic_measures.name: Copper Oxychloride + Canopy Pruning
organic_measures.method: Prune dead twigs 5 cm below infected zone; spray copper oxychloride (3 g/L).
organic_measures.frequency: Before blossom and after fruit set

chemical_measures.name: Azoxystrobin 23% SC or Carbendazim 50% WP
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Apply during flush and panicle emergence.

prevention_measures: Post-harvest hot water treatment of fruit (52°C for 5-10 minutes).
Keep orchard floor clean of fallen twigs and leaves.
sources: ICAR-Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture (CISH) Lucknow
University of Florida IFAS Mango Diseases

bacterial_canker.symptoms: Water-soaked angular dark brown lesions surrounded by clear yellow halos on leaves, raised corky canker lesions on twigs and fruit with gum exudation.

organic_measures.name: Copper Hydroxide + Canopy Pruning
organic_measures.method: Spray copper hydroxide (2.5 g/L) and remove cankered twigs.

chemical_measures.name: Streptocycline + Copper Oxychloride
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Apply before fruit maturation.

prevention_measures: Establish windbreaks around orchard edges to minimize wind-driven leaf abrasions.

powdery_mildew.symptoms: White powdery fungal coating on inflorescence, young leaves, and tender fruits, causing heavy blossom drop and fruitlet drop.

organic_measures.name: Wettable Sulphur 80% WP or Potassium Bicarbonate
organic_measures.method: Spray wettable sulphur (2-3 g/L) or potassium bicarbonate (3 g/L).
organic_measures.frequency: At bud burst and fruit set

chemical_measures.name: Hexaconazole 5% EC or Dinocap 48% EC
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Do not spray during extreme heat (>35°C) to avoid phytotoxicity.

prevention_measures: Ensure good sunlight penetration through annual pruning.
Scout panicles weekly during foggy cool mornings.

die_back.symptoms: Drying and die-off of twigs and branches progressing from top downwards. Leaves turn brown, roll, and remain attached to dead twigs.

organic_measures.name: Deep Pruning & Bordeaux Paste Dressing
organic_measures.method: Prune affected branches 7-10 cm below the dead margin and paste fresh 10% Bordeaux paste or copper oxychloride paste onto cut surfaces.

chemical_measures.name: Thiophanate Methyl 70% WP or Carbendazim
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Foliar spray over remaining canopy after pruning. Wear PPE.

prevention_measures: Avoid stem borer and insect injuries which provide entry wounds for fungal spores.
Paint tree trunks with lime-copper wash.

cutting_weevil.symptoms: Tender new leaves cleanly cut near the base like by scissors and lying scattered beneath tree canopy.

organic_measures.name: Collection of Cut Leaves & Neem Spray
organic_measures.method: Collect and destroy dropped cut leaves (which contain weevil eggs). Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) during new flush.
organic_measures.application: Foliar spray during new leaf flush

chemical_measures.name: Quinalphos 25% EC or Lambda-cyhalothrin 5% EC
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Apply only on tender flushes if damage exceeds threshold.

prevention_measures: Till soil under tree basin to expose pupae to predatory birds and sun.

gall_midge.symptoms: Small wart-like or cone-shaped galls on upper and lower leaf surfaces, resulting in leaf curl and premature drop.

organic_measures.name: Neem Oil & Pruning Galled Leaves
organic_measures.method: Prune heavily galled shoots before adult midges emerge. Spray neem oil (5 ml/L).

chemical_measures.name: Dimethoate 30% EC or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Target new flush. Avoid during bloom. Wear PPE.

prevention_measures: Rake and expose orchard basin soil to destroy pupae.

sooty_mould.pathogen: Meliola mangiferae / Capnodium spp. (Saprophytic Fungi on Insect Honeydew)
sooty_mould.symptoms: Black velvety superficial powdery/crust layer covering leaf surfaces, reducing photosynthesis, accompanied by hoppers/scale insects.

organic_measures.name: Starch / Maida Paste Spray
organic_measures.method: Boil 1 kg wheat flour (maida) / starch in 5 L water, dilute to 20 L (5% starch solution) and spray on leaves. Dries into flakes and peels off mold.

organic_measures.name: Neem Spray against Sucking Insects
organic_measures.method: Spray neem oil (5 ml/L) to control hoppers and mealybugs that secrete the honeydew.

chemical_measures.name: Wettable Sulphur + Imidacloprid (for vector insects)
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Targets both saprophytic mold and honeydew insects.

prevention_measures: Control mango hopper and scale insect populations early before honeydew accumulates.

mango_healthy.symptoms: Glossy dark green leaves, vigorous shoot flushes, clear bark, healthy panicles.

organic_measures.name: Basal Organic Manuring
organic_measures.method: Apply 50 kg well-decomposed farmyard manure + 2 kg neem cake per mature tree basin.

prevention_measures: Maintain annual post-harvest center-opening canopy pruning.
